questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The overpass ahead has a low clearance.
Two lanes of traffic moving in opposite directions are about to merge.

questions.correctAnswerText: The overpass ahead has a low clearance.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that an overpass is coming with low clearance. Do not pass under it if your vehicle is taller than the height shown on the sign (13 feet, 6 inches in this case).

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No turns are allowed on this road.
There are a series of curves ahead.
The road may be slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: There are a series of curves ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road has three or more curves coming up.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Eight-sided signs tell you to stop at the intersection. You must give the right-of-way to other traffic. You may proceed when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a crossroad is coming ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: When pavement is wet, reduce your speed.
The road ahead winds a series of turns or curves.

questions.correctAnswerText: When pavement is wet, reduce your speed.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road is slippery when wet. When it rains, slow down, avoid sudden braking or turning, and increase your distance from the car ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: You can use hand signals instead of or along with turn signals. When your left arm is bent at the elbow pointing upward, it signals a right turn or lane change to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a T-shaped intersection is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead has a series of turns or curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow and black. They alert drivers to upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign tells you that a lane is ending and you need to merge safely with other traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Trucks are permitted on an upcoming narrow bridge.
The bridge ahead is open to one-way traffic only.
The bridge ahead is wide enough for only one car at a time.
The bridge ahead may be too narrow to meet or pass a truck.

questions.correctAnswerText: The bridge ahead may be too narrow to meet or pass a truck.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns that an upcoming bridge is too narrow for you to safely meet or pass a truck. Be careful and use caution.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep hill is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns you that the divided highway is ending.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: When a lead rider extends their left arm straight out with palm facing down and then swings it down to their side, following riders should slow down.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Lane ends or roadway narrows ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Lane ends or roadway narrows ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns you that the right lane is ending or the road is narrowing.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a four-way intersection is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Hand signals are used instead of or along with turn signals. When a rider's left arm is bent at the elbow and pointing down, it means they are slowing down or stopping.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed where the sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must drive slowly and sound your horn.
You are entering a school's parking lot.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells you that you are approaching a school zone. You should slow down and watch for children.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means right turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A community service group is picking up trash along the highway ahead.
Workers are on or very close to the road in the work zone ahead.
There is a pedestrian crosswalk ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Workers are on or very close to the road in the work zone ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that workers may be on or near the roadway ahead. Drive carefully through the work zone.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Traffic lights display colors from bottom to top in this order: green, yellow, and red.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells drivers what they must and must not do. This sign means you cannot park here.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Traffic flows only in the direction of the arrow.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic flows only in the direction of the arrow.
questions.explanation: This one-way sign tells you that traffic must move only in the direction shown by the arrow.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This triangular sign means yield. Slow down and check for traffic. Let pedestrians and oncoming vehicles pass first. Only stop if necessary.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Look for a train station ahead.
Slow down and yield for trains.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield for trains.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that railroad tracks are ahead. Slow down when you approach the crossing. Trains cannot stop for cars, so you must wait for trains to pass before crossing the tracks.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves right. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
Divided highway begins. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
Merge. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
Winding road ahead. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road curves to the right. Reduce your speed to the safe speed shown on the sign (35 mph in this case).

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Highway changes ahead and to the right.
Hiking trails ahead and to the right.
Hotel ahead and to the right.
Hospital ahead and to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Hospital ahead and to the right.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a hospital with emergency services is located to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Always stop before entering the intersection.
Yield just to the traffic on the right.
Yield just to the traffic on the left.
Slow down and yield the right-of-way to other traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield the right-of-way to other traffic.
questions.explanation: A yield sign means slow down and let other traffic pass first before you enter the intersection or roadway.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.
Don’t park on the right side of the street.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a slash means the action shown is not allowed. This sign prohibits right turns.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: You can use hand signals instead of or in addition to turn signals. Hold your left arm straight out to the left to signal a left turn or lane change to the left.
